scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'mvnw.cmd clean package -DskipTests' : './mvnw clean package -DskipTests'; execSync(cmd, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.test: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'mvnw.cmd test' : './mvnw test'; execSync(cmd, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.lint: echo 'No lint script configured for gateway-service'
